name: Hong Kong
prevalence_note: ADCC and OFCA 2025-2026: fake WeChat/Alipay '百萬保障' & Taobao customer service FPS transfer-verification scams, cross-border fake Mainland police or HK Immigration officers, OFCA/telecom prepaid-SIM suspension calls, fake Customs/courier parcel holds, 'guess who' bail scams, and English official/bank impersonation dominate.
cross_border_note: Under OFCA directives, Hong Kong mobile operators prepend '+' to all calls originating outside Hong Kong, play or display a mandatory '+852' overseas spoofed-call alert ('Call is from outside Hong Kong. Beware of deception.'), and play a bilingual Cantonese/Putonghua voice alert ('Call is made from a new prepaid SIM card') for newly activated local prepaid SIM cards under real-name registration rules; syndicates also route overseas calls through local '2', '3', or '58' prefixes registered via shell companies.

scams.name: 假冒內地公安／入境處職員（跨境普通話・保密令・資產清查）
scams.name_en: Cross-border Putonghua/Chinese fake Mainland Public Security or HK Immigration asset-check scam
scams.signals_en: Often speaks Putonghua or accented Cantonese posing as HK Immigration, Security Bureau, or Mainland Public Security claiming the victim's HKID or Mainland SIM card is tied to cross-border money laundering...
scams.legit_en: Mainland law enforcement never conducts cross-border phone enforcement in Hong Kong, and real HK officials never issue phone secrecy orders, show warrant cards on messaging apps, or request transfers to prove innocence.
bait_tactics: 裝作很緊張配合，說身份證和銀行存摺鎖在書房抽屜底要慢慢找鑰匙，請他先解釋清楚保證金審核流程
故意聽不清楚案件編號和部門名稱，請他逐個字重唸一遍，順便追問資產清查大概需要幾個工作天
說家裡網絡訊號很差開不到視像通話，問能不能自己親身去灣仔入境事務大樓櫃檯核實

scams.name: 假冒微信／淘寶／支付平台客服取消「百萬保障」扣費騙案
scams.name_en: Fake WeChat, Alipay 'Million-Dollar Guarantee' or Taobao support FPS verification & screen-sharing scam
scams.signals_en: Poses as WeChat, Alipay, Taobao, or Pinduoduo customer service claiming the victim activated a 'Million-Dollar Guarantee' insurance plan or paid VIP subscription that will auto-deduct monthly fees tonight...
scams.legit_en: Genuine WeChat, AlipayHK, and Taobao support never cold-call users to cancel '百萬保障' or ask for live screen sharing, FPS test transfers ('過數驗證'), or one-time passwords.
bait_tactics: 好奇怪喎，我平時好少用呢個功能，你等我搵返部舊手提電話睇下當初係用邊個電郵登記先
我而家開極個網上理財都轉緊圈載入唔到，地鐵入面收得好差，不如我自己入返官方程式度撳取消啦
你話今晚會自動扣錢係咪呀？但係我呢個轉數快戶口入面得返幾十蚊散紙，應該扣唔到㗎喎

scams.name: 「猜猜我是誰」假冒親友換號碼急需保釋金騙案
scams.name_en: 'Guess who' relative with new number urgently demanding bail or emergency cash
scams.signals_en: Calls elderly or local residents in Cantonese asking 'Don't you recognize my voice?', claims to have changed phone numbers or caught a cold, and pleads for urgent police bail or accident settlement money via unfamiliar FPS/bank accounts or cash handed to a...
scams.legit_en: Hong Kong police and courts never phone relatives to demand instant transfers to personal accounts or send strangers to housing estates to collect cash bail.
bait_tactics: 你把聲聽落重感冒好沙啞喎，我一時真係聽唔出係邊個親戚，不如你講返上次飲茶我哋坐邊張枱先
咁大件事我一個人做唔到主㗎，你等陣先，我而家即刻打返去你原本嗰個舊電話號碼問清楚
我今日冇帶提款卡出街，銀行櫃檯呢個鐘數又排晒長龍，不如我叫屋企後生仔直接去警署搵你啦

scams.name: 假冒通訊辦及電訊商停用電話號碼／儲值卡騙案
scams.name_en: Fake OFCA or telecom operator urgent number or prepaid SIM suspension scam
scams.signals_en: Impersonates the Office of the Communications Authority (通訊辦 / OFCA) or a mobile carrier claiming a prepaid SIM card registered under the victim's HKID sent mass scam messages, threatening to suspend all phone numbers within two hours and routing the call...
scams.legit_en: OFCA never calls members of the public regarding phone billing or SIM suspension, never asks for HKID or bank details over unsolicited calls, and never forwards calls to Mainland or local police.
bait_tactics: 呢個電話號碼我上台用咗好多年月費㗎喇，點會無端端停機呀？你寄封正式通知信去我帳單地址先講啦
我而家喺公司開緊會唔方便抄嘢，放工之後我自己落去電訊商門市櫃檯查返清楚咪得囉
你話有人用我名義開咗張儲值卡，咁你講返清楚係邊間電訊商同埋幾月幾號登記先，我完全冇印象喎

scams.name: 假冒香港海關／速遞公司扣件（違禁品・補繳清關手續費）
scams.name_en: Fake Hong Kong Customs or courier parcel contraband & clearance-fee scam
scams.signals_en: Spoofs Hong Kong Customs enquiry numbers or poses as courier staff claiming an inbound parcel contains contraband and is detained, demanding an immediate clearance penalty, app download, or transfer to 'Mainland border officers'.
scams.legit_en: Hong Kong Customs never demands fine transfers by phone or asks citizens to install unofficial mobile apps; genuine courier pickup notices are verified inside the official courier app.
bait_tactics: 扮好擔心咁話最近冇印象買過外國嘢，請佢逐件講清楚個包裹入面裝住咩同埋寄件人寫邊個
話張信用卡擺咗喺屋企另一個手袋度要慢慢搵，請佢先詳細解釋清關手續費係按重量定按件數計
話自己唔識撳手機連結，問可唔可以抄低個檔案編號自己親身去北角海關總部大樓問清楚

scams.name: Fake Immigration Department / HKPF / Bank Safe-Account English Scam
scams.name_en: English-language fake HK Immigration, Police Force or bank safe-account scam
scams.signals_en: Targets English speakers and expatriates in Hong Kong via pre-recorded or live calls spoofing +852 official numbers; impersonates the Immigration Department, HKPF, Communications Authority...
scams.legit_en: The Hong Kong Police Force, Immigration Department, and licensed banks never make pre-recorded threat calls, forward calls to outside police forces, or ask for online banking passwords or asset-verification transfers.
bait_tactics: Sorry, I am riding the MTR right now and the connection keeps dropping—could you repeat your division name slowly?
Hold on, I don't keep my HKID or bank token with me at work; let me verify this through the official police anti-scam helpline first.
My online banking daily transfer limit is locked at zero anyway, so can you mail the written notice to my registered residential address?
